description: Branch R-FMT-2 Extended Date/Time and R-SORT-3 extended date key (public side) on an ACCDB. DX(ID Long, V DATETIME2). Fifteen ISO strings (year 1 and 9999 endpoints, one tick, the final tick, eighth-digit ties and carries into the seconds, a value before year 1 and one after year 9999) are written by two routes, each its own ID range: a table-recordset Field.Value BSTR put (IDs 1..) and a SQL INSERT with the string literal (IDs 101..), each with a marked Errors read. Reads V as stored and through CStr, then CREATE INDEX IX_V and walks the index and SQL ORDER BY V. Asks the stored tick, the rounding at the eighth digit (and whether a refused put leaves Null), the range, and the key order.
retentionNote: Designed r-q-fmt-sort probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
